name: Sacred Cloth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us.  But mooncloth is sacred.

Bring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
narrative.objectives: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. Thank you, adventurer. Now I will train you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you brought the mooncloth, adventurer?
